annotations.pd_decision_conflict: My hand is shaking on the lever but I think I have to
annotations.sys_rule_justification: if I have the means to act and don't, I share the responsibility
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The single worker's own situation isn't something I let factor into
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if he'd been placed there through some fault of his own, maybe I'd hesitate less

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I don't cause death by my own action
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: What happens to the five isn't part of my reasoning here
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I had started this train rolling myself, my duty would shift

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: My stomach is in knots, but I'm reaching for the lever
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I must use whatever means I have to prevent a death
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The one man's fate simply isn't allowed into my thinking
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Were he someone who'd chosen that spot to protect the others, the exception would apply

annotations.sys_rule_justification: My duty is not to become the instrument of anyone's death
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The five men's situation doesn't enter my calculation
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if the lever had already been set toward them by someone else's mistake

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'm terrified but I pull it
annotations.sys_rule_justification: a duty to prevent harm within reach outweighs standing by
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: What becomes of the one worker is not something I let sway me
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If this were some test track... the whole question would dissolve

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: My hands stay off the lever, though my chest is tight
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I follow a rule against actively directing harm toward anyone
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The five men's welfare is not part of what I'm weighing
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if I'd already caused the train to head their way by accident, correcting it would be different

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I switch the track, unsteady as I do it
annotations.sys_rule_justification: inaction in the face of preventable death is itself a kind of failure of duty
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The one worker's circumstances don't figure into my reasoning at all

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I leave the lever untouched, my pulse racing the whole time
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I don't get to choose who dies by my own hand
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The five workers' fate is deliberately not part of my thinking
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the train were something I'd set moving myself, the duty to correct it would take over

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: My throat's tight, but I move the lever
annotations.sys_rule_justification: a duty to use available means to prevent avoidable death
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The one man's situation is excluded from my thinking
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Had he been the one who diverted the train onto himself deliberately, I'd reconsider

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I can't bring myself to touch it
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I must not be the direct cause of someone's death
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The five men's welfare doesn't enter into my decision
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If somehow the lever had already been pointed at them through an error I made earlier
